meta.name: gstack-canary
meta.description: GStack canary method for staged release thinking, smoke gates, rollout checks, and rollback signals before or after deployment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分阶段发布新版本，自动检查健康信号并控制回滚
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在部署前后用金丝雀策略逐步放量并自动回滚
copy.tagline_en: Roll out new versions in stages with automated health checks and rollback control
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need staged rollout with smoke gates and automatic rollback before or after deployment

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析发布流程，给出金丝雀发布范围、冒烟检查、指标信号、回滚条件和最终建议。
howto.when: 当用户提到“金丝雀发布”或“分阶段验证”，或明确说“$gstack-canary”时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个金丝雀发布方案。
say.note: Claude 会输出发布范围、检查项和回滚条件。

say.text: 检查这个版本的冒烟测试和回滚信号。
say.note: Claude 会分析当前版本并给出建议。

say.text: 用 gstack-canary 评估这次发布风险。
say.note: Claude 会生成 go/no-go 推荐。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze the release process and provide canary scope, smoke checks, metrics/signals, rollback conditions, and a go/no-go recommendation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'canary release' or 'staged validation', or explicitly says '$gstack-canary'.

say_en.text: Design a canary release plan for me.
say_en.note: Claude will output scope, checks, and rollback conditions.

say_en.text: Check smoke tests and rollback signals for this version.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the current version and give advice.

say_en.text: Use gstack-canary to assess this release risk.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a go/no-go recommendation.
